faqs.q: What are Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 used for?
faqs.a: U-tubes in copper, admiralty and aluminium brass and copper-nickel to ASTM B395, for coolers and condensers with removable bundles. Bends are relief-annealed where the alloy needs it, and a dual-gauge tube with a heavier bend section is available.

faqs.q: What sizes can Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 be supplied in?
faqs.a: Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 can be supplied in the size you need (Made to your drawing; standard geometry in the description). Tell us the size or capacity you need, and the application, through the enquiry and we confirm the dimensions and the part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. With the bend schedule: centreline radius and leg length for each row, and any heat treatment of the bends. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: How tight can the bends be on Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395?
faqs.a: The bend radius for Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395: 1.5×OD centreline radius available; dimensional tolerances guaranteed from 2×OD.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395?
faqs.a: For Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395, testing follows the governing standard: Eddy current before bending; Hydrostatic at 48 MPa fibre stress (≤6.9 MPa) or pneumatic 400 kPa for 5 s, on each U-tube. Mercurous nitrate / ammonia vapour on bend and leg for brasses. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 available in?
faqs.a: Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 are available in these grades: C12200 etc.; C44300–C44500; C68700; C70600/C70620; C71500/C71520; C72200.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395?
faqs.a: Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 are made to ASTM B395/B395M, ASTM B111, ASTM B135, ASTM B68, BS 2871, BS EN12451, EN 12735-2, JIS H3300. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395, U-tubes go into the tube sheet of a removable-bundle exchanger at both ends and are held by baffles or support plates, so the bend schedule must match the bundle layout. Related ranges are the [Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes](/c/alloy-steel-u-bend-tubes) and [Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes](/c/carbon-steel-u-bend-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: Where are Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 used?
faqs.a: Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 are used for: U-tube feedwater heaters, coolers and chillers. Tell us the duty and the site conditions and we confirm it suits the job.

faqs.q: Can Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 be supplied to customers outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the delivery country and the drawing or data sheet through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.a: Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes, ASTM B395 are made to your drawing or data sheet rather than held as catalogue stock, so the lead time is confirmed with the quotation.
